item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/NIKE_2019_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data['texts']
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    if re.search(r'principal executive offices', txt, re.I):
        start=max(0,i-5); end=min(len(texts), i+10)
        for j in range(start,end):
            tt=texts[j]
            print(j, tt.get('page_no'), repr(tt.get('text','')))
        print('---')
PY"
